svg.title: sharness-ai contain, as designed: one sentence, compiled down five levels to one hash, with what is held and what is not
svg.text: designed 26 Oct 2026, not yet code: level 5, the sentence a person says
sharness-ai contain one sentence, compiled to the kernel, named by one hash
you said contain claude to ./my-repo, github.com and pypi.org, no secrets
it became profile coding-agent (4) → 11 rows (3) → 2 doors, 3 targets (2) → 14 kernel rules (1)
the name sha256:9f31a0c47d2e…c2a0 one hash; every level below is recomputed from it at launch
held ✔ 11 of 11 rows by the kernel: the workspace writable, the system read-only, nothing else reachable
not held ⚠ the host names: github.com and pypi.org are held as port 443 until sharness.net runs here
not covered UDP (DNS), Unix sockets by path, the environment claude inherits
deeper sharness-ai explain the same sentence drawn level by level
